test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A sum of Rs. 900 is divided into two parts such that the interest on the first part at 4% simple interest per annum and that on the other part at 2% simple interest per annum are equal. What is the interest accumulated on each part in a year?
solution:
**Given:-**

Total sum = Rs. 900

Rate % on the 1st part = 4%

Rate% on the 2nd part = 2%

**Formula Used:-**

S.I = PRT/100

Where,

P = Principal,

R = Rate,

T = Time

**Calculation:-**

Let the two parts be x and (900 - x)

According to the question

S.I on the 1st part = S.I on the 2nd part 

⇒ (x × 4 × 1)/100 = [(900 - x) × 2 × 1]/100

⇒ 4x = 1800 - 2x

⇒ 6x = 1800

⇒ x = 300

 So, The interest on each part = 4x/100

⇒ (4 × 300)/100 ⇒ 12 

**∴ Simple interest on each part is Rs. __12__.**
